_note: LLM unit pricing for the cost tracker. Prices are USD per 1M tokens. fxUsdInr converts to rupees; override at runtime with env LLM_FX_USD_INR. Models are matched by the FIRST substring found in the logged model name (order matters). Qwen (OpenRouter) rows come first, specific-before-generic, so 'qwen/qwen3.5-flash-02-23' resolves to the Qwen row and never to the generic Gemini 'flash'. Gemini (Vertex list price) rows last: 'flash' before 'pro'. Vertex verified 1 Jul 2026; OpenRouter Qwen verified 19 Jul 2026 from openrouter.ai/models.
